meta.title: فرض الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 3)

paper:
Hello! I am Adam. I am in grade five. My school is big and nice. There are twelve classrooms and a big playground. In my schoolbag, I have got two books, a blue pen, a red pencil case and a ruler. My teacher is Mr Karim. He is very kind. My favourite subject is English.

(Text written by the site)

Exercise 1 (4 pts)

Read and answer True or False:

  1. Adam's school is small.
  2. There are twelve classrooms.
  3. His pen is blue.
  4. His favourite subject is maths.

Exercise 2 (3 pts)

Write the numbers in letters: 12 → ...... ; 2 → ...... ; 15 → ......

Exercise 3 (3 pts)

Match the classroom instruction with its meaning:

Open your book.اجلس.
Sit down.استمع.
Listen.افتح كتابك.
solution:
Exercise 1

Answer keyMarksTotal

1) False (it is big) ; 2) True ; 3) True ; 4) False (English).

4×14

Exercise 2

Answer keyMarksTotal

twelve ; two ; fifteen.

3×13

Exercise 3

Answer keyMarksTotal

Open your book → افتح كتابك ; Sit down → اجلس ; Listen → استمع.

3×13
